name: radio-group
title: Radio group
description: Pick exactly one option from a short list.
a11y: role=radiogroup with role=radio items; one Tab stop for the group.
Arrow keys move and select; Space selects the focused item.
Give the group an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label shown next to the radio. Without it, give the item an `aria-label`.

usage:
import {RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem} from '@monoline/react';

<RadioGroup aria-label="Plan" defaultValue="monthly"><RadioGroupItem value="monthly" label="Monthly" /><RadioGroupItem value="yearly" label="Yearly" /></RadioGroup>
